schedule_design.method: Each 30-minute workflow run backfills the six most recent closed Bithumb 5-minute candles for every stage2 finalist, so one extraction contains the full 30-minute time path.
schedule_design.orderbook_tradeflow_method: Use current live orderbook/trade flow and compare them with the persisted prior 30-minute run; public historical 5-minute orderbooks are not available for retroactive backfill.

professional_decision_contract.probability_rule: Scores and grades are not calibrated probabilities; numeric probability claims require prospective calibration.
